items.name: Angkor National Museum
items.description: An air-conditioned museum offering context on Khmer civilisation before or after temple visits.
items.image_credit: Photo: Wikipedia/Wikimedia Commons (licence on file page) - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angkor_National_Museum

items.name: Angkor Night Market
items.description: An evening market for crafts, textiles and snacks near Pub Street.
items.image_credit: Photo: Wilsen Escandor, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3AAngkor_night_Market%2C_Cambodia.jpg

items.name: Angkor Sunrise Tour
items.description: guided pre-dawn tuk-tuk visit to Angkor Wat for sunrise, then breakfast.
items.image_credit: Photo: Laurent Dambies, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3AAngkor_Wat_Photography_Tour.jpg

items.name: Angkor Wat
items.description: The world's largest religious monument, a 12th-century Khmer temple famous for its sunrise silhouette.
items.image_credit: Photo: Wikipedia/Wikimedia Commons (licence on file page) - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angkor_Wat

items.name: Apsara Dinner Pavilion
items.description: Buffet & show. Buffet dinner with a traditional dance performance.
items.image_credit: Photo: Radosław Botev, CC BY 3.0 pl via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3ASiem_Reap_old_market_(4).jpg

items.name: Banteay Samre
items.description: A well-preserved 12th-century temple east of the main circuit, usually quiet.
items.image_credit: Photo: Wikipedia/Wikimedia Commons (licence on file page) - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Banteay_Samr%C3%A9

items.name: Banteay Srei
items.description: A small 10th-century temple celebrated for delicate pink sandstone carving; about 35 km from town.
items.image_credit: Photo: Wikipedia/Wikimedia Commons (licence on file page) - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Banteay_Srei

items.name: Bayon Temple (Angkor Thom)
items.description: A temple of serene stone faces at the heart of the walled city of Angkor Thom; included in the Angkor pass.
items.image_credit: Photo: Wikipedia/Wikimedia Commons (licence on file page) - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bayon

items.name: Cambodia Landmine Museum
items.description: A community museum on demining and the work of its founder, about 25 km from town.
items.image_credit: Photo: Gary Todd from Xinzheng, China, CC0 via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3ALand_Mines_(9733041706).jpg

items.name: Chong Kneas Floating Village
items.description: A lake-edge floating community on the Tonle Sap; choose community-run options.
items.image_credit: Photo: Christine  Zenino from Chicago, US, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3AChong_Kneas_floating_village_(4380157829).jpg

items.name: Countryside Bicycle Tour
items.description: ride quiet village roads past rice paddies and local homes.
items.image_credit: Photo: LBM1948, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3ASiem_Reap%2C_varios_03.jpg

items.name: Kuy Teav Alley Stall
items.description: Khmer street food. Morning noodle soup beloved by tuk-tuk drivers.
items.image_credit: Photo: yashima from Karlsruhe, Germany, CC BY-SA 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3ASiem_Reap_street_food_(15932997329).jpg

items.name: Old Market (Psar Chas)
items.description: A central market for food, textiles and souvenirs, lively in the evening.
items.image_credit: Illustrative photo of Siem Reap. Photo: Yjfstorehouse, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3AStreets_of_Siem_Reap_A14.jpg

items.name: Old Market Lok Lak House
items.description: Khmer. Beef lok lak with lime-pepper dipping sauce.
items.image_credit: Photo: Fred Bigio from Marseille, france, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3ASiem_Reap_restaurant_(5862249201).jpg

items.name: Phare, The Cambodian Circus
items.description: A performance by graduates of an arts school, combining acrobatics, music and theatre.
items.image_credit: Photo: flowcomm, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3APhare_Circus%2C_Siem_Reap%2C_Cambodia.jpg

items.name: Preah Khan
items.description: A sprawling 12th-century monastery complex with long corridors and fewer crowds.
items.image_credit: Photo: Wikipedia/Wikimedia Commons (licence on file page) - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Preah_Khan

items.name: Pub Street
items.description: The town's compact nightlife and dining strip, busiest after dark.
items.image_credit: Illustrative photo of Siem Reap. Photo: Marcin Konsek, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3A2016_Siem_Reab%2C_Pub_Street_noc%C4%85.jpg

items.name: Ta Prohm
items.description: The 'jungle temple' where massive tree roots entwine the ruins; included in the Angkor pass.
items.image_credit: Photo: Wikipedia/Wikimedia Commons (licence on file page) - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ta_Prohm

items.name: Temple Road Roastery
items.description: Cafe. Light-roast coffee and pastries before temple tours.
items.image_credit: Photo: Su--May from London, UK, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons - https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File%3ACafe_Central_(10513155644).jpg

items.name: Wat Bo Vegan Garden
items.description: Vegetarian. Plant-based Khmer-inspired dishes served in a garden.
